titles.title: showStatusMenu offers EXACTLY three items, including Model Tiers, and routes each choice to the matching panel
Cancel path: a dismissed menu (undefined) opens no panel (ac1)
openDetailedStatus creates ONE panel with the daemon/workflows/debug tabs, defaults to daemon, renders gateway.status() (ac2)
the shared shell styles form controls with theme variables — selects/dropdowns do not fall back to the browser white ground
Degraded render: a rejected gateway.status() still opens the panel + tabs with an error body and never throws
a setHtml throw (e.g. panel disposed mid-render) degrades to a logged no-op — never an unhandled rejection or a sync throw
single-instance: a second open reveals the same panel + switches tab, and after user-close a later open creates fresh
openRepoConfiguration creates/reveals the separate Repo Configuration shell (single-instance)
S005: openDetailedStatus renders the daemon tab from detailRenderers.daemon (ac1)
S005: a {switchTab:'workflows'} message re-invokes the workflows renderer exactly once and re-sets the html (ac2/ac3)
S005: a {refresh} message re-invokes the ACTIVE tab renderer exactly once (ac3)
S005: NO timer/interval is armed — with no message the renderer call-count stays flat (no background poll, ac3)
S005: an unknown message type, or switchTab with an invalid tab, is a silent no-op
S005: a late switchTab/refresh after the panel was disposed is skipped
S005: the rendered Detailed Status shell carries a strict CSP + a per-render nonce on the only inline script
S006: the controller is armed ONLY after the webview {ready} handshake — never before (MED-1 fix: the initial batch is not posted into a not-yet-loaded document)
S006: activating the debug tab calls onActivate; switch-away / re-activate / panel-close dispose it EXACTLY once (one live)
S006: refresh stops then re-arms the ticker on the fresh document (re-seeds the log; LOW-1 fix)
S006: a controller ctx.postMessage lands on the panel, and the shell wires the appendLog listener via textContent
S006: a {type:'action',action} message is forwarded to onDetailAction; a malformed action is a silent no-op
S006: a host built with no tabControllers/onDetailAction behaves exactly as the S005 shell (no throw, no ticker)
S006: never-throw — an onActivate throw, a dispose throw, and an onDetailAction throw are all caught + logged
S007: openRepoConfiguration renders the wired repoRenderer body; with no repoRenderer it renders the S004 placeholder unchanged
S007: a {selectRepo} message re-renders via repoRenderer(selectedRepo); a {repoWrite} forwards a validated RepoConfigWrite
S007: a malformed selectRepo/repoWrite is a silent no-op (no re-render, no forward, no throw)
S007: the empty selectRepo option clears the selection back to picker-only
S007: a repoRenderer throw (config read reject) degrades to an error body; an onRepoConfigWrite throw is caught
source-scan: webview-host.ts imports no vscode module (extension.ts stays the sole vscode importer)
a {repoRegisterProviders} message forwards a validated RepoProviderRegistration to onRepoRegisterProviders; malformed ones are silent no-ops
the repo bootstrap script posts repoRegisterProviders with the checked data-provider values
S001: openModelTiers always opens/reveals the panel (never a no-op); with no modelTiersRenderer it renders the placeholder
S001: a {kind:'tierField'} modelTiersWrite forwards a validated ModelTiersWrite; a {kind:'coreFloor'} one too; malformed ones are silent no-ops
S001: a modelTiersRenderer throw degrades to an error body; an onModelTiersWrite throw is caught
the model-tiers bootstrap script posts modelTiersWrite for both a tier field change and the core-floor change
the shared shellHtml style block defines .section/.section-head/.count/.rows/.role-row/.provider-row/.status-chip/.floor-row rules
